## Key Insights

1. Summer Sowing Status: As on March 28, 2025, the area sown under the summer crops is 53.92 lakh ha as compared to 48.59 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. Of this, area of 30.50 lakh ha has been sown under rice this year against the previous year area of 26.55 lakh ha (increase of 3.95 lakh ha).
2. Rabi harvesting Status: As on 27.03.2025, 48.48 % of area has been harvested all over India. Approximately 77.00% area of Pulses mainly in Lathyrus (91%), Urdbean (86%), Kulthi (81%), Moongbean (74%); 62.76% area of Shri Anna & Coarse Cereals mainly in Jowar (91.73%); 77.00% area of Oilseeds majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (80.30%); and 29.37% area of Rice has been harvested for Rabi crops 2024-25.
3. Rabi Season Area Coverage : For Rabi horticulture crops , major producing states report the following sowing areas: Onion - 10.93 lakh ha (9.73 lakh ha last year), Potato - 19.95 lakh ha (19.56 lakh ha last year), Tomato - 2.94 lakh ha (3.12 lakh ha last year).
4. Weather Update :
- a) Temperature: Gradual rise in maximum temperatures by 2-4°C likely over East and Northwest India and no significant change during next 3-4 days. No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over rest parts of the country during till 4th April.
- b) Rainfall Distribution: From Mar 01- 01 April, 2025, the All-India cumulative rainfall is 34% lower than its Long Period Average (LPA), with regional variations: (i) East & Northeast India: -42%; (ii) Northwest India: -42%; (iii) Central India: -40%; and South Peninsula: +29%.

A Cyclonic Circulation lies over Marathwada & neighbourhood in lower tropospheric levels. A fresh Western Disturbance is likely to affect Western Himalayan Region from 3rd April 2025. Thunderstorm, lightning & gusty winds likely over Madhya Pradesh, Vidarbha, Telangana, Coastal Karnataka, Kerala & Mahe, Konkan & Goa, Madhya Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Marathwada, Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam, Interior Karnataka during 01st to 04th April; Gujarat State on 01st & 02nd April; Gangetic West Bengal, Jharkhand, Rayalaseema during 02nd -04th April. Hailstorm likely over Madhya Pradesh, Vidarbha during 01st - 04th ; Madhya Maharashtra, Marathawada on 01st & 02nd; Chhattisgarh, Telangana on 02nd & 03rd ; Odisha during 02nd-04th; Jharkhand on 03rd& 04th; North Interior Karnataka during 01st-03rd; South Interior Karnataka on 03rd April.
